description:
CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, and now we're expanding our platform to solve broader sales planning challenges. Recognized by industry analysts like Gartner, Forrester and G2 and backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia, ICONIQ, Accel, and Sapphire Ventures,  we empower high-growth companies like Netflix, Figma, and Stripe with the flexibility and insights needed to drive revenue performance. 

Join a talented, fast-growing team committed to solving some of the most complex and impactful problems in sales performance management.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Designer to shape and execute creative across the many applications that put CaptivateIQ in front of customers and prospects, including campaigns and paid media, web, events, social, and brand.

You'll partner closely with our Creative Director and teams across Marketing, Product, and Engineering to turn business objectives into distinctive creative ideas and exceptional execution. You'll help evolve CaptivateIQ's creative vision while owning the creative direction and point of view for the initiatives you lead.

This role is for someone who can think big and execute at a high level of craft, using AI as a core part of how you work to move faster without losing quality. You'll develop concepts, sharpen ambiguous briefs, sweat the details, and carry ideas from early thinking through finished work. You'll bring an AI-first mindset to the templates, systems, and workflows you build, embedding your taste and judgment so the output stays distinctive, not just fast.

What You'll Do

  • Shape and evolve CaptivateIQ's visual identity in partnership with the Creative Director

  • Develop concepts and creative direction for integrated campaigns, turning marketing strategy into distinctive ideas, and bring that direction to life across social, presentations, email, events, and other key marketing surfaces

  • Design and ship high-impact web experiences, including the homepage, solution pages, and campaign landing pages

  • Create and iterate paid advertising across channels like Meta, LinkedIn, and display, using performance insights to improve the work

  • Partner with motion, video, developers, agencies, and vendors to bring ideas to life across mediums

  • Encode a high bar for taste into the templates, libraries, and workflows you build with AI, so Marketing moves faster without losing it

  • Use AI throughout your own process, from concepting to production, to increase the volume and speed of high-quality creative you can personally ship

  • Bring strong taste, intuition and judgment to the work, articulating your point of view and helping raise the quality of creative across the organization

  • Have a keen eye for the competition in the space, crafting competitive assessments alongside the Creative Director and bringing those findings to the team

  • Explore what qualitative brand customer/prospect research can evolve into at CaptivateIQ, as a method to establish genuine understanding and differentiation within the market place

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years of experience in brand or marketing design, in-house or agency, ideally in B2B SaaS, technology, or another fast-moving environment

  • A strong portfolio of concept-driven work demonstrating exceptional craft across campaigns, web, social, print, event design and other marketing surfaces

  • Excellent fundamentals across typography, composition, layout, and visual hierarchy, with the attention to detail that makes every piece feel intentional and refined

  • Strong conceptual thinking and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear creative ideas

  • High ownership and self-direction, with a track record of independently leading work from concept through execution

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including presenting work, articulating rationale, leading creative reviews, and building alignment across stakeholders

  • An understanding of how design influences brand perception, campaign performance, and business outcomes

  • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and AI tools and workflows to move from concept to finished output quickly

  • Hands-on experience creating paid ad creative that's shipped into market on channels like Meta, LinkedIn, or display, with informed opinions about what performs and why

  • Bonus: Motion, video, or interactive design experience is a plus, including using AI tools to extend your range into different mediums.

What Success Looks Like

  • You independently lead meaningful creative initiatives from concept through execution

  • You turn ambiguous direction into strong creative decisions, not just execution

  • Your work makes CaptivateIQ's brand more distinctive, cohesive, and recognizable

  • You use performance and business context to make the work stronger

  • Your systems carry your taste at scale, so creative velocity goes up without the work losing its edge

  • The AI tools you use measurably increase your output and impact, not just your experimentation

  • You know when to move fast and when to slow down to get the details right

  • Your judgment and craft raise the quality of the work around you

Why This Role Matters

  • The way CaptivateIQ shows up shapes how customers understand who we are, what makes us different, and why we matter.

    As Senior Designer, you'll have meaningful ownership over that experience, from the ideas behind our campaigns to the details of how they come to life. You'll help evolve our brand, raise our creative bar, and build the systems that allow great work to scale.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Healthcare: 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for all FTEs, with roughly 75% coverage for dependents.

  • Flexible Time Off: Flexible vacation days plus quarterly mental health days to ensure you have the space to recharge.

  • Annual Stipends: Dedicated funds for your professional development and caretaking needs.

  • Work Anniversary Bonuses: Annual bonuses to celebrate your milestones and contributions to the CaptivateIQ team that grow as your tenure does.

  • Retirement Savings (US-Only): A 401(k) plan to help you invest in and secure your future.

  • Premium Tools: The latest Apple hardware to empower you to do your best work.

  • Inclusive Community: Active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that celebrate shared identities and support our DEI goals by fostering an environment where diverse talent thrives.
